scope.notes: This helper consumes a separately qualified snapshot and freezes actual bytes and resolution paths. This review does not establish that any real checkpoint object has completed original-import/runtime/facet qualification.

current_census_comparison.notes: Selected exact census SHA bytes from main, source-only ImbalancedChen, or source-only refactored paths. All 247 project import lists matched the original driver parser and the fixed inspector parser before the delta.

verified_properties: A source graph with actual native ancestry requires an explicitly qualified external snapshot, including transitive project ancestors.
Historical schema-2 records and baseline objects lacking native binding cannot acquire schema-3 acceptance merely by matching object bytes.
Native context binding includes the snapshot byte hash, canonical context signature, helper source hash, explicit actual Lean search roots and sysroot.
Each supplied native source/object/provider receipt and declared physical runtime/import file is hashed; native source imports and Git blob identities are rechecked.
Native module dependency closure signatures are recursively bound; missing native imports and cycles are rejected.
Actual native import resolution is checked against the earliest package root, including rejection of earlier incomplete package directories.
Fresh native records persist as exit 125/new_strict_compile false while awaiting the final batch postcheck; successful credit is only persisted after matching external pre/post bindings.
A changed external environment invalidates both newly compiled and reused affected records in the completed batch.
Independent replay and declaration audit both bind the external snapshot and actual project object paths; mutation prevents acceptance.
For the exact current finite project graph, schema-2 closure signatures remain compatible. Default drivers now require helper and the fixed inspector to be deployed together.

additional_read_only_probes.probe: Commented native import is ignored by the robust parser
A later unused package directory does not replace an earlier qualified native object
Missing object at an earlier native package root cannot fall through

findings_resolved.initial_observation: The prior project imports() scanner ignored public import ImbalancedChen.Mid and could omit indirect native ancestry in future sources using this valid syntax. No such difference occurred in the exact 247 current project sources.
findings_resolved.resolution: Shared project imports() now reuses the immutable inspector parser; added test confirms no-snapshot rejection and schema-3 binding with a snapshot.

findings_resolved.initial_observation: The old helper docstring claimed no-external calls do not import it, but both drivers unconditionally import the ancestry marker.
findings_resolved.resolution: The docstring now correctly states that no-external calls do not instantiate ExternalSnapshot, while both drivers use the marker and fixed parser.

remaining_boundaries: The qualification producer adapter is outside this review. Before any real native cache acceptance it must actually qualify selected source/object/import/runtime/facet evidence; a status label or a source pin alone is not that evidence.
The original fixed Mathlib/core environment remains the existing declared boundary; this review did not rebuild it.
Fixture executable results establish control-flow and provenance validation behavior only, not Lean theorem validity.
